rawContent: We watched a youtube video of bfs watching their gfs getting hit on/catcalled, Twan turns to me and asks if it ever happens to me. I tell him almost every single time I walk alone - I could tell it hurt and angered him. I am also part of the #metoo

I no longer bite my tongue when I feel disrespected (I thank Twan for that). I used to be a mouse now I talk back. It angers me that men feel like women owe them anything - I don't owe you dicks shit #metoo
